_metadata.description: Deterministic ground-truth benchmark scenarios for multi-hypothesis attribution, adaptive traversal, and stability analysis. All blockchain hashes and addresses in this file are synthetic test fixtures.

scenarios.name: Direct Uncommingled Flow to VASP
scenarios.description: Victim deposits 10,000 USDT to suspect wallet. Suspect transfers entire 10,000 USDT to Binance hot wallet with 0 pre-existing balance.

scenarios.name: 90k Pre-Existing Balance Commingling
scenarios.description: Suspect wallet has 90,000 USDT before victim deposits 10,000 USDT. Suspect then makes two transfers: 5,000 USDT to Wallet A, then 95,000 USDT to Wallet B.

scenarios.name: Consensus Attribution on Single VASP
scenarios.description: All 4 models attribute majority victim value to OKX deposit infrastructure.

scenarios.name: Model Disagreement on Dominant VASP
scenarios.description: FIFO points to Binance (first outgoing), LIFO points to Kraken (last outgoing).

scenarios.name: 250-Way 0.4% Dust Fragmentation
scenarios.description: Victim deposits 10,000 USDT. Suspect disperses funds into 250 outgoing branches of 40 USDT each (0.4% per branch).

scenarios.name: Rapid Successive Peeling Chain
scenarios.description: 10,000 USDT forwarded across 4 hops retaining small cuts: 10k -> 9.1k -> 8.2k -> 7.4k -> Binance.

scenarios.name: Uniswap v3 Swap Continuation
scenarios.description: Suspect swaps 10,000 USDT for 3.2 ETH via Uniswap v3 SwapRouter and forwards ETH to secondary wallet.

scenarios.name: Deterministic Protocol-ID Bridge Match
scenarios.description: Multichain deposit event on Ethereum matches destination event on Polygon with exact message ID.

scenarios.name: Heuristic Bridge Match (Amount + Recipient + Tight Window)
scenarios.description: Cross-chain transfer with matching token, amount within 2%, matching recipient, within 10 minutes, but no message ID.

scenarios.name: Uncorrelated Cross-Chain Candidate
scenarios.description: Destination candidate has amount mismatch (50k vs 10k) and timestamp 5 days later.

scenarios.name: Tornado Cash Privacy Boundary
scenarios.description: Victim funds reach Tornado Cash router contract.

scenarios.name: 180-Day Label Staleness Degradation
scenarios.description: VASP attribution record verified 300 days ago.

scenarios.name: Conflicting Entity Attribution from Different Sources
scenarios.description: Registry loads conflicting entity labels for same address.

ground_truth.known_limitation: Registry overwrites earlier source rather than preserving multi-source dispute

scenarios.name: Multiple Matching Candidate Transactions (Level B Ambiguity)
scenarios.description: Complaint specifies wallet, asset, amount, and timestamp. 3 transactions match within 60 minutes.

scenarios.name: Depth-12 Graph Reaching Max Hops Cap
scenarios.description: Transaction path continues linearly past max_hops=8.

scenarios.name: Service Popularity Normalization on Convergence
scenarios.description: 50 cases hitting Binance hot wallet (10M monthly volume) vs 4 cases hitting unknown intermediary wallet (0 monthly volume).
